notes: The existing and queued lists already cover essentially all of Ysaÿe's published violin works: the solo sonatas Op. 27, the poems Opp. 12, 13, 15, 21, 23 and 29, the mazurkas, the Berceuse, Divertimento, Fantaisie, Amitié, the 2-violin sonata, the Preludes Op. 35, the Paganini Variations, the Étude posthume and the E minor concerto. The remaining items are omitted: the 'Le Londres' trio has a viola and falls outside the accompaniment scheme, Opp. 16, 22 and 28 are for cello, and Ysaÿe's own arrangements belong under the original composers (e.g. Saint-Saëns' Caprice en forme de valse). The posthumous solo sonata and the 'Exercices et gammes' are left out because I cannot confidently name a published edition.
